# Jared Burrows

> Software engineer with 10+ years building mobile, cross-platform, and cloud
> products for Adobe, Google, Microsoft, Nike, NBCUniversal, Yahoo, and Northrop
> Grumman. I specialize in Android and Kotlin development, shipping award-winning
> apps used by millions. Open-source maintainer and conference speaker, including
> Droidcon.

A personal site: one page of bio and conference talks, plus a machine-readable
twin of each. Everything below is an anonymous GET — this origin has no
authentication, no user data and no write surface.

## Site

- [Homepage in Markdown](https://jaredsburrows.com/index.md): the whole page as
  markdown — the summary above, where else I publish, and every talk with its
  slides and video. The site root serves these same bytes to a request whose
  `Accept` names `text/markdown`.
- [Talks dataset](https://jaredsburrows.com/api/talks.json): the talks as JSON,
  newest first, each with its date, title, venue, location, event link, abstract
  and — where they exist — Speaker Deck and YouTube ids.
- [Talks API](https://jaredsburrows.com/api/openapi.json): OpenAPI 3.1
  description of the two read-only endpoints over that dataset, advertised in the
  RFC 9727 catalog at
  [/.well-known/api-catalog](https://jaredsburrows.com/.well-known/api-catalog).
- [Agent manifest](https://jaredsburrows.com/.well-known/ard.json): everything
  this origin offers an agent, in one file. Served byte-identically at
  [/.well-known/ai-catalog.json](https://jaredsburrows.com/.well-known/ai-catalog.json).

## Policies

- [Authentication](https://jaredsburrows.com/auth.md): none, ever. No issuer, no
  protected resources, and no registration route worth probing for.
- [Crawl and training permissions](https://jaredsburrows.com/robots.txt):
  `ai-train=yes, search=yes, ai-input=yes` for every user agent, with nothing
  disallowed.
- [Security contact](https://jaredsburrows.com/.well-known/security.txt): where
  to report a vulnerability.

## Optional

- [Blog](https://blog.jaredsburrows.com): longer posts, usually about Android or
  Gradle.
- [Mobile apps](https://burrowsapps.com): Android apps I've published under
  BurrowsApps.
- [GitHub](https://github.com/jaredsburrows): gradle-license-plugin, plus repos
  I should archive.
- [LinkedIn](https://linkedin.com/in/jaredsburrows): the resume version of all
  this.
